title: power_curve
description: Payload of `stride power-curve`. `fit_r2` is how well the CP line fits its own 5-20 minute bests, and is the query-independent way to weigh the fit. The regression is power against 1/duration, so a LOW value means those bests do not fall on a line at all: CP and W' are then drawn through scatter, and small changes in the inputs swing them a long way. A high value says the line is a good description, NOT that the model describes the athlete — bests taken from steady efforts rather than maximal ones sit on a near-flat line that fits well and yields an implausibly small W'. `fit_r2` is 1 by construction at exactly two points (a line through two points is exact), and 0 when no fit was made at all — `cp` of 0 is what says there is no fit. It is only a quality signal when `fit_points` is 3.
